name: B10-0118/2024 (ECR) – The cases of unjustly imprisoned Uyghurs in China, notably Ilham Tohti and Gulshan Abbas
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the cases of unjustly imprisoned Uyghurs in China, notably Ilham Tohti and Gulshan Abbas
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for China to release Ilham Tohti and Gulshan Abbas, two Uyghurs it says are wrongly imprisoned. It also asks China to let them see their families and lawyers, and to give information about where they are and how their health is. It condemns China's treatment of Uyghurs and other minorities in Xinjiang, including detention camps, and asks the Council to keep sanctioning officials responsible for abuses.

- Nothing changes yet: this is the Parliament's opinion and request, not a law.
- It targets China's government, two named prisoners and Uyghurs in Xinjiang.
- Next, the resolution is sent to China's government and parliament; China is not obliged to act.
